statement: Harness was not run; no docker, VM, or hosted endpoint was contacted. Operator verifies on the host after merge that a real teardown leaves zero images for its project.
change: _teardown_project in scripts/run_isolated_l12_runtime_e2e.py now passes '--rmi local' to 'compose down'. The preclean, final teardown and --down entry point all use this one function.
criterion_2_local_not_all: Flag value is 'local' only; test asserts 'all' is absent from the down args, so images with an explicit image: field (postgres, redis, nats, minio) are kept.
criterion_3_test: test_teardown_down_command_carries_all_profiles asserts the token after --rmi is 'local' and 'all' not in down args.
